title: The Second Book of the War Fan
summary: Pairs the spreading edge slash with a step and the crossed-rib deflect with a turn for students past the primer.

title: Drills for the Spread and Shut
summary: Drills the sweeping hook and the counter twist that join a guard to a cut for early qi users.

title: A Workbook of Ribs and Rhythm
summary: Builds a steady rhythm of cuts and catches so the pin catch and glare step come without thought.

title: Breath Work for the Iron Fan
summary: Ties each heavy iron fan block and crushing chop to the breath for students who carry the weighted fan.

title: The Rib-Edge Sequence Book
summary: Chains rib cuts folds and slips into short sequences that end in a pressing close-range finish.

title: Handbook of the Turning Leaf
summary: Shows how turning the open leaf traps a sword blade and covers the cutting arm in one motion.

title: On Binding with the Fan Ribs
summary: Teaches wrist locks collar hooks and disarming pulls made with the ribs of the fan.

title: Practical Fan Counters
summary: Gathers the quick counters that slice through a guard and capture a thrust with the closing leaf.

title: The Pleated Blade Course
summary: Runs through folding counters dust-sweep sidesteps and wrist locks as the last course before the advanced texts.
